What do we think about Dragon Knight

I think you have to play Dragon Knight in push strats only these days since he is kind of lackluster. Let him get a fast level 6 and push towers whenever his dragon form is off cooldown but he most likely fell off the meta for this patch because of the popular mid heroes just destroy him in lane.

He's out of favour in the current meta but is a strong hero at what he does (pushing). You have to play him as a pusher and take advantage of that or he'll probably just fall off in the late game (unless he gets really farmed).

His passive gives him pretty good sustain in lane and 'Breath Fire' gives him good wave clear. Stun's a bit lacklustre and if I'm honest I essentially ignore until you have dragon form (which makes the stun ranged) when it can actually be used without having to walk right up to the enemy. Builds nice and tanky and is generally pretty hard for right clickers to kill. Absolutely needs BKB this patch.
The thing is, there seem to be so many better option than DK for whatever role DK could fill.
I think you can say that about a lot of heroes to be honest. Which ones do you think make good alternatives to DK in his role?

I mean there are so many supports that push better than DK. Im saying if DK is in your lineup, you need a new line up. Sven can push with his warcry and cleave if we forget about a straight support and go back to strength heroes. His stun is so SO much better. He gets going quicker too. Get a mask of madness and some treads and your good to go for the time being. Lycan can push like crazy. Or a Nature's Prophet. And if we are talking straight up tankability he is lacking there as well. Id rather have a Wraith King or a Tiny. DK damage output is also bit 'meh'. You can get him to be significant, sure, but it takes so much shit to do it. There's also broodmother. I'd rather have any of those than a DK. I'd like a Naga as well.

Sven doesn't push anywhere near as well as DK sorry. He will carry harder late game as a right clicker and Tiny as you mentioned will carry harder late game, push harder and be tankier, but he needs Agh's first. Sven's stun is better, but he doesn't have the nuke damage to follow it up and it's mana cost is pretty huge. Both are stronger late game (Sven probably at pushing as well), but I don't think they do DK's role better than he does.

DK comes out ahead in pushing power in the earlier game (i.e. as soon as he hits level 6 because of the bonus damage over time from his ult). And is arguably a stronger teamfighter in the mid game (though Tiny will give more nuke if he manages to land the toss combo).

NP is a completely different type of hero. He's almost pure split-push, never fight with the team kind of style which isn't what you're meant to do with DK at all.

Lycan I think is probably the closest in terms of role, but Lycan can't teamfight as early as DK. He plays slightly more like NP again with the strong split push, though has more potential to fight with the team later on (good flexible hero offering different types of style...)

Naga takes much longer to come online (she needs items before she can start the whole split push thing), and at that her split push is more 'keeping the lanes pushed' rather than 'wrecking buildings' the way DK pushes. Again though she probably has a stronger late game.

I'm not sure if you understand DK's role terribly well. He's an early-mid game pusher that can teamfight. That's why he fit so well in the 'deathball' meta at TI last year. It's also why he doesn't work terribly well in pubs at low-to-mid level where trying to get teams to group up and push doesn't work very well.
Again for early/mid game, I'd rather have any other hero, Panda, Axe, WindRanger, Broodmother. All those heroes (Panda and brood not as much) continue to be more useful as the game progresses.

But none of those heroes fit the same role which is what we're talking about.

Panda/Axe/Windranger aren't going to demolish towers in the early/mid game. They all have decent wave clear, but they can't just knock buildings down (like DK, Shadow Shaman, Pugna, Leshrac for example). Brood can demolish towers but won't be able to fight outside of whatever lane she sets up in (and honestly isn't really comparable to anyone...)
But DK can't really demolish towers. Don't over sell him here.
